state_key.recognition: one of m=N-1 weak proposers is drawn uniformly and independently of theta and h2

primitives_used.population: N=m+1>=3; after weak proposer i is counted yes, n=N-2=m-1 weak nonproposers vote
primitives_used.ballot: H and all weak nonproposers vote simultaneously and independently conditional on their information sets; no correlation device
primitives_used.passage: pass if and only if H and all m weak states vote yes; proposer is already counted yes
primitives_used.pass_payoffs: H gets y; weak j!=i gets named x_j; proposer i gets r_i
primitives_used.failure_payoffs: every weak state gets 0 and type theta of H gets o_theta
primitives_used.H_no_outcome: immediate opt-out and quota-impossible terminal outcome
primitives_used.equality: yes when a payoff-relevant comparison is equal; zero relevance permits an explicit assessment completion
primitives_used.proposal_tie_break: after maximizing the recognized proposer payoff, minimize H's expected payoff; retain a correspondence if both tie

notation.p_j: independent yes probability of weak nonproposer j
notation.Z: set of weak nonproposers with p_j=0

H_best_response.sure_weak_failure: when P_W=0, opt-out status makes the action relevant and the zero monetary difference selects H-yes

weak_best_response.strategy: p_j=1 if a_rho P_minus_j>0; any p_j in [0,1] if it equals zero
weak_best_response.zero_offer: x_j=0 still selects yes at positive relevance probability

complete_independent_behavioral_correspo.weak_strategy_if_a_rho_zero: each p_j may be any number in (0,1] independently
complete_independent_behavioral_correspo.a_rho_zero_cases: y<o_0 for any rho; or o_0<=y<o_1 and rho=1

complete_independent_behavioral_correspo.conditions: |Z|>=2; exists if and only if N>=4
complete_independent_behavioral_correspo.weak_strategy: zero components remain zero and every positive p_j may be arbitrary in (0,1]

fixed_proposal_ballot_interface.excluded_profile: exactly one p_j=0 is never a ballot equilibrium
fixed_proposal_ballot_interface.pure_profiles: either every weak nonproposer votes yes and H uses its threshold, or N>=4 and at least two weak nonproposers vote no while both H types vote yes
fixed_proposal_ballot_interface.product_safe_warning: positive-product mixing at rho=1 may change the true low-type passage probability after an off-path proposal and must be retained through proposal optimality

type_conditional_payoff_vector.weak_nonproposer_j: u_j(theta)=h_theta P_W x_j for every named j

terminal_distribution_and_payoffs.external_outside_option: failure payments o_theta are not subtracted from the unit weak surplus

belief_interface.on_support_proposal: rho(s)=nu because the weak proposer does not know theta
belief_interface.globally_off_path_proposal: rho(s) is an explicitly recorded assessment component in [0,1]
belief_interface.deviation_distribution: the proposer's payoff from deviating is integrated under the true preproposal nu, not the off-path ballot belief rho
belief_interface.weak_vote: an uninformed weak vote is not direct evidence about theta
belief_interface.post_ballot: the vote vector may reveal theta, but the game is terminal and no successor belief enters an action or payoff
belief_interface.degenerate_posterior: strategies and type-conditional payoffs are recorded for both H types even when nu is 0 or 1

components: ballot belief rho_i(s) at every feasible proposal
one fixed-proposal ballot element b_i(s) from the exact ballot correspondence at every proposal
full type/player payoff and terminal-outcome distributions
proposal_assessment_definition.tie_break: among maximizers, every support proposal minimizes hbar(s,b_i(s);nu)
proposal_assessment_definition.mixing: proposal mixing is allowed only among support elements tying in both quantities; differing payment or outcome distributions then remain in the correspondence

canonical_pooling.conditional_payoffs: for both types: proposer G, other weak state 0, H o_1

separating_family.value_domain: 0<V<=L_nu and V>=G; when G=0 this is the nonclosed interval (0,L_nu]
separating_family.ballot_and_outcome: weak voter yes; low H yes and passage; high H no and opt-out
separating_family.type_0_payoffs: proposer r_i, other weak x, H y
separating_family.tie_at_V_equal_G: forced pooling ties the proposer but pays strictly more to H, so the authorized proposal tie-break selects separation

nu_less_than_1.G_zero_pooling_rejection: if o_1=1, canonical pooling payoff 0 cannot suppress every positive-residual separating deviation to exactly zero and is not a PBE
nu_less_than_1.off_path_construction: at every separating deviation set rho=1 and select a sufficiently small but strictly positive weak yes probability; pooling deviations cannot exceed G

nu_equal_1.G_positive: canonical pooling is the unique on-path monetary outcome
nu_equal_1.G_zero: every fixed-proposal ballot equilibrium is proposal-stage admissible; actual weak payoffs are zero and actual high H payoff is o_1=1; proposal mixtures and counterfactual low-type objects remain

recognized_proposer_N3.on_path_mixing: for nu<1 no new nontrivial proposal mixture survives the proposal tie-break; for nu=1 and G=0 the full tied correspondence remains
recognized_proposer_N3.existence: nonempty for every primitive and posterior

recognized_proposer_Nge4.proposer_scalar_payoff_projection: the exact projection is [0,M_nu], but downstream users must consume the vector correspondence, not only this interval

positive_separating_passage.proposal: r_i=V/(1-nu); o_0<=y<o_1; y+r_i<=1; sum_j x_j=1-y-r_i with arbitrary nonnegative named distribution
positive_separating_passage.ballot: all weak nonproposers yes; low H yes; high H no
positive_separating_passage.type_0_payoffs: proposer r_i, named weak vector (x_j), H y

positive_pooling_passage.proposal: r_i=V; o_1<=y<=min{y_bar,1-V}; sum_j x_j=1-y-V with arbitrary nonnegative named distribution
positive_pooling_passage.ballot: all voters and both H types yes
positive_pooling_passage.type_conditional_payoffs: for both types: proposer V, named weak vector (x_j), H y

recognized_proposer_Nge4.support_construction: assign coordinated failure with at least two zero weak yes probabilities to every off-support proposal; every selected positive passage outcome is then a strict proposer optimum

classes: if nu<1, separating passage only with r_i=0 and y=o_0
if nu=1, every separating positive-product completion
if nu=1, pooling passage exactly with y=o_1 and r_i=0; feasible named gifts may consume 1-o_1
zero_payoff_class.mixing: retain mixtures over tied zero-payoff/H-payoff outcomes, including distinct opt-out, failure, payment, and counterfactual-type distributions

recognized_proposer_Nge4.gift_and_support_implication: positive named gifts and oversized unanimous support survive in both positive passage classes; no coalition minimality or zero-gift property is derived
recognized_proposer_Nge4.existence: nonempty for every primitive and posterior

pre_recognition_C2_correspondence.assessment_index: alpha selects one recognized-proposer PBE element e_i for each i=1,...,m; selections may be identity-asymmetric
pre_recognition_C2_correspondence.outcome_distribution: apply the same uniform average to pass-with-H, weak-caused-failure, and H-optout probabilities conditional on each type
pre_recognition_C2_correspondence.history_index: the full public h2 and nu remain distinct interface indices; equal nu does not force the same assessment selection
pre_recognition_C2_correspondence.selection_status: set-valued; no selection beyond the two frozen tie conventions
pre_recognition_C2_correspondence.transport_rule: a Round-1 consumer imports a literal selected element and applies beta exactly once where its own transition reaches this state

boundaries.N_at_least_4: coordinated failure exists after every feasible proposal
boundaries.o_0_equal_0: the y<o_0 region is empty; all other formulas are unchanged
boundaries.o_1_equal_1: G=0; N=3 with nu<1 has a proposer payoff set open at zero, while N>=4 includes zero
boundaries.nu_equal_0: use the nu<1 branches and retain counterfactual high-type strategies/payoffs
boundaries.nu_equal_1: record counterfactual low-type strategies/payoffs even though proposal optimality uses the actual high type
boundaries.y_bar_equal_o_1: pooling proposals above o_1 disappear; canonical pooling remains feasible

existence_and_multiplicity.existence: PBE exists for all N>=3, nu in [0,1], and 0<=o_0<o_1<=y_bar<=1
existence_and_multiplicity.proposal_multiplicity: exactly the N=3 and N>=4 assessment-level families above
existence_and_multiplicity.selection_warning: do not collapse the interface to a scalar continuation value or impose symmetry, coalition minimality, zero gifts, or a joint yes completion

invalidation: any change to the frozen Gate 0 bundle, ballot relevance, simultaneous information, proposal space, budget, terminal failure, equality convention, belief discipline, or proposal tie-break invalidates this interface and every descendant
artifact_hash_protocol: SHA-256 is computed externally over the exact UTF-8 bytes of this candidate JSON; storing the digest inside the hashed file would be self-referential
